data.one_liner: Create glassmorphic frosted glass containers with backdrop blur and gradient borders.
data.what_it_does: Provides customizable widgets like GlassmorphicContainer and GlassmorphicFlexContainer to produce frosted glass visual effects. It supports backdrop blur, gradient fills, gradient borders, custom drop shadows, and flexible sizing.
use_when: You want to build a frosted glass UI design in your Flutter app.
You need containers with backdrop blur, gradient borders, and clean drop shadows.
avoid_when: You are targeting platforms or older devices where BackdropFilter performance or support is inadequate.
You are rendering many overlapping blurred elements which can cause performance bottlenecks.
strengths: Supports sizing by child or fixed dimensions.
Provides custom drop shadows that stay outside the translucent fill.
Includes a flex-friendly variant for rows and columns.
weaknesses: Heavy usage of blurred backdrop filters can degrade rendering performance.
Platform views like Google Maps or web views may not blur properly on iOS.
data.minimal_example:
GlassmorphicContainer(
  width: 350,
  height: 350,
  borderRadius: 20,
  blur: 20,
  border: 2,
  linearGradient: const LinearGradient(
    colors: [Color(0x1AFFFFFF), Color(0x0DFFFFFF)],
  ),
  borderGradient: const LinearGradient(
    colors: [Color(0x80FFFFFF), Color(0x80FFFFFF)],
  ),
  child: const Text('Glass'),
)
